commentary.text: 90+3' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle after Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
90+1' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) has a goal ruled out for offside!
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
88' Substitution. Remy Cabella is replaced by Tiago Morais (Lille).
87' The substitution is prepared. Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Edon Zhegrova.
85' Laszlo Boloni has decided to make a change. Ibou Sane (Metz) replaces Kevin N'Doram.
83' Ismael Traore (Metz) brings an opponent down and Stephanie Frappart interrupts the game.
81' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Lille out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
77' It is time for a substitution. Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) is on for Yusuf Yazici.
77' The free kick from long range, taken by Lille, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
76' Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Stephanie Frappart ignores the protests.
74' Kevin N'Doram (Metz) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Stephanie Frappart signals.
73' Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post.
72' Matthieu Udol (Metz) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
70' Laszlo Boloni prepares a substitution. Danley Jean Jacques is replaced by Cheikh Sabaly (Metz).
70' Substitution. Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) replaces Pape Diallo.
69' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
66' A lofted cross from Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

65' What a chance! Matthieu Udol (Metz) squanders a promising opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the right post!
62' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
60' Matthieu Udol (Metz) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
55' That was close by Edon Zhegrova (Lille)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
54' Great teamplay by Lille as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
51' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) is given a yellow card.
50' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
47' Lille are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
46' Half-time substitution. Arthur Atta (Metz) will not participate anymore and Lamine Camara is coming on.
46' Laszlo Boloni makes a half-time substitution. Ablie Jallow comes on in place of Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz).
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' A pass into the penalty area from Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is intercepted by the defence.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

44' 1 - 2 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Yusuf Yazici (Lille) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the left post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Alexandre Oukidja, so the score changes to 1:2.
43' Maxime Colin (Metz) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
42' The cross into the penalty area from Matthieu Udol (Metz) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
41' Lille move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
40' The Lille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
37' Jonathan David (Lille) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Stephanie Frappart didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
35' A pass by Lucas Chevalier (Lille) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
31' 1 - 1 Ismaily (Lille) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
30' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Edon Zhegrova (Lille), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
30' The Lille players are exchanging some short passes.
27' Metz fail to score from a corner as Lucas Chevalier (Lille) leaps to collect the ball.
27' Pape Diallo (Metz) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Lucas Chevalier.
26' The resulting set piece from Lille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
26' None of the Lille players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
23' 1 - 0 Goal! Lucas Chevalier gets a hand on the penalty from Georges Mikautadze (Metz), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
22' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) is going to take the penalty!
22' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Metz!
21' Referee Stephanie Frappart makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Metz. Let’s see what happens!
21' Surely that's handball by one of the Lille players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
17' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

17' Nice move, nice attempt! Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
16' The game is pretty dull as Lille are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
14' A pass from Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) is intercepted by Alexandre Oukidja and the move breaks down.
13' Remy Cabella (Lille) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
11' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
10' A cross by Jonathan David (Lille) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
8' That's a well-taken pass by Remy Cabella (Lille). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
7' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
6' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
2' Arthur Atta (Metz) is flagged for offside.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Metz will take the kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
